== Ingredients ==

=== '''Meats''' ===
Choose 1 or 2 of the following items:

*4 fresh whole Maltese [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausages]]
*4 shoulder-cut [[Cookbook:Pork#Loin|pork chops]] (ideally left attached in one piece and separated only after cooking)
*1 piece (300 g) fresh [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] belly, salt-cured [[Cookbook:Gammon|gammon]], or smoked [[Cookbook:bacon|bacon]]

=== '''Other ingredients''' ===
*1 [[w:ham hock|ham hock]] or a [[w:pig's trotter|pig's trotter]] (not boned)
*[[Cookbook:Oil|Oil]] for [[Cookbook:Frying|frying]] the onion
*2 large [[Cookbook:Onions|onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 whole medium [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]], cut into medium chunks
*2 large [[Cookbook:Potatoes|potatoes]], cut into medium chunks
*1–2 [[Cookbook:Kohlrabi|kohlrabi]], cut into medium chunks
*1 large slice of red-fleshed [[Cookbook:Pumpkin|pumpkin]] (''qargħa hamra''; optional), cut into medium chunks
*1 large slice of yellow-fleshed [[Cookbook:Pumpkin|pumpkin]] (''qargħa Torka''; optional), cut into medium chunks
*½ [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. medium [[Cookbook:Cauliflower|cauliflower]] (optional), cut into medium chunks
*3–4 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]] (optional), cut into medium chunks
*[[Cookbook:Chopping|Chopped]] green [[Cookbook:celery|celery]] leaves (Maltese ''krafes'')
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[Cookbook:pepper|Pepper]]
*1–2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]], diluted with a little water
*A few sprigs of flat-leaf [[Cookbook:parsley|parsley]], chopped

== Procedure ==

# Bring a pot of water to a rolling [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], and scald the hock or trotter in it for 10 minutes.
# Remove the hock or trotter, discard the water, refill with fresh water and bring to the boil again. 
#Place the hock or trotter in the boiling water with the other meats you are using, turn heat down, and cook a few minutes, skimming scum from the surface.
#When there is no more scum forming, remove the meats from the water. Reserve both the cooking water and all the meats.
# In a pot over medium heat, soften and wilt the onion in the olive oil without letting it brown.
# Add the cabbage, potatoes, kohlrabi, pumpkin, cauliflower, carrots, and celery leaves. Season with salt and pepper, cover, and [[Cookbook:Sweating|sweat]] together on low heat for 5–6 minutes
# Add the tomato paste and reserved meats.
# Add some of the water in which you boiled the meats (the quantity depends on whether you want a one-dish stew or a two course meal, see below). [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] over moderately low heat until the meats are tender.
# Five minutes from the end of cooking time, taste and adjust for seasoning, then add the chopped flat leaf parsley.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If using salt-cured gammon, soak in cold water over night to remove the saltiness.
* Maltese sausages are made of ground lean and fat pork with garlic, parsley, salt, black peppercorns, and coriander seeds.
* It is not traditional to cook pasta in the soup, neither is it customary to grate cheese on top.
* If serving as a one course meal, you are aiming for a chunky stew, so you don't want to add too much liquid. Serve with crusty bread.
* If serving as a two course meal, you will want enough liquid to serve a soupy first course. The meats you remove, slice if necessary and keep warm to serve alone or maybe with a little light tomato sauce. You can cook a small amount of rice in the vegetable soup if you wish, though it is hardly necessary.
